runs.text: Sixty two percent of Israeli women are in the workforce, working or looking for work. Is that a lot? Let's race twelve countries since nineteen ninety. In nineteen ninety, America leads with fifty six percent. Britain is next. Israel, forty six. Then Israeli women keep joining. In two thousand and one, Israel passes Britain. In twenty eleven, America. Saudi Arabia climbs from fifteen percent to thirty three, most of it after twenty seventeen. Egypt, Jordan, Iran and Syria are still under one in five. The UAE nearly doubles, from twenty nine to fifty three. Turkey reaches thirty seven. Germany starts just behind Israel, and ends at fifty six. What gets more women into work? Tell me in the comments. So who leads all twelve? Israel. Sixty two percent.
